summary: A downward cancellation wand reaches a floor potion through zap_updown -> bhitpile -> zap.c:bhito. The C WAN_CANCELLATION arm calls cancel_item, redraws the object and returns the default affected result; js/zap.js refuses this immediate effect before it can change the potion or continue the callback.

source.branch: bhito: floor object differs from the wand and is not bypassed; WAN_CANCELLATION selects cancel_item(obj), then newsym(obj position), then returns res=1 without learnwand.
callers: zap.c:zap_updown -> zap.c:bhitpile -> zap.c:bhito for downward wand zaps
dependencies: zap.c:cancel_item at line 1239 is not implemented in JS; the callback can only match the object mutation after this void callee is ported

evidence: C zap.c:2119-2173 handles identity, bypass, floor-location and ball/chain guards before its effect switch. The WAN_CANCELLATION arm at 2313-2317 calls cancel_item(obj) and newsym(obj->ox,obj->oy); learn_it stays false and the callback returns res=1 at 2424-2426.

C zap.c:1239 defines cancel_item. JS js/zap.js:2999-3089 has only striking, opening/locking and polymorph/stone-to-flesh arms; for this wand type it throws UnsupportedZapError before the floor object changes. cancel_item has no JS implementation.

C zap.c:3392-3399 passes bhito to bhitpile on a downward zap. JS js/zap.js:3392 reaches bhito through bhitpile. The v12 independently recorded C case stops at zero-based step 48 with 48 of 53 screens matched and 5 remaining (challenges/evaluations/20260929033350-v12.json).
